## Shipdeck 0.9.4 for Windows and Linux

- **Marketing on any site.** Channels are no longer only subreddits: add your YouTube channel, Instagram, Facebook,
  Threads, TikTok or X account, or a group someone else runs. Each post shows its views beside its score.
- **Every post is read back.** After Claude posts, Shipdeck opens the post and compares it with the draft you
  approved. Lines that are missing wait for you in Needs You, with Open Post, Check Again and It's Fine.
- **Claude posts and comments more reliably.** In the browser a session can wait for a page to finish, read a feed
  post by post, and send up to 20 comments in one approval, each shown under its post. It can also upload files from
  another of your products, which you are shown by name. Enter in a comment box no longer sends without you.
